title: Canonical raw module-cohomology comparison is locally bijective
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, any scheme morphism h:Y→X, integer q, and bounded-below derived module-sheaf object K, the canonical morphism higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf Λ h q K, from raw restricted derived-Hom cohomology classes to the underlying abelian presheaf of H^q(Rh_*K), is both locally injective and locally surjective for the small etale topology [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The derived categories and direct images are those of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. This records an already proved source-library declaration, not a new Lean statement.

proof.text: Use the source-library derived adjunction isomorphism higherDirectImagePresheafIso. The proved isLocallyBijective_derivedHomToHomology identifies derived maps from free representables locally with homology sections: cycles lift locally, and zero classes lift locally through boundaries. Compose with the invertible homology-shift comparison. The source proof establishes the identity of this composite with higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf by freeSheafSections_naturality. Local injectivity and local surjectivity are preserved by composition with these isomorphisms.
